_comment: Single source of truth for one client's EOD and client-journey system. Every value marked YOUR_ or left blank is set per client. Read by the Node service (api/, lib/) and the Python Notion builders (scripts/). Anything saved later on /settings (team, targets, reminder times) overrides the matching default here.

business.name: Your Brand
business._note: Leave the image URLs blank to show the business name as a text wordmark. currency is an ISO code (USD, GBP, EUR); locale controls number and date formatting.

_public_base_note: The https address this app is deployed at, e.g. https://your-eod-app.example.com. PUBLIC_BASE_URL in the environment overrides it. Used in links inside Discord posts, Notion pages and watch links.

notion._note: parent_page is the Notion page everything is built under. sales_db is the lead CRM database; scripts/00_sales.py creates one if you do not have one and writes its id back here.

ghl._note: Optional. Only used to build links into GoHighLevel and to read stage names sent by GHL webhooks.

stages.name: 1. Social & DMs
stages.advances_via: Setter logs the DM conversation, or an ad or organic click lands on the site with attribution captured.
stages.definition: A named inbound conversation exists: DM, comment reply or tagged referral. Not yet on the website.

stages.name: 2. Website
stages.advances_via: Automatic. The tracker (t.js) on your website records the visit, and the application form reports how far the visitor got.
stages.definition: A tracked visit to the site. One row per session in Site Sessions, with channel, landing page and furthest application step.

stages.name: 3. Application
stages.advances_via: Automatic. The application form posts to the GHL webhook, which creates the contact and the Notion Sales row.
stages.definition: The application is submitted in full and lands in GHL and Notion.

stages.name: 4. Initial VSL
stages.advances_via: Automatic. GHL emails the tracked watch link; the watch page reports open, play, watch depth and completion back to Notion.
stages.definition: The applicant has opened the Initial VSL watch page. Watch depth is recorded so a 5% skim is distinguishable from a real view.

stages.name: 5. Triage Call
stages.advances_via: The triage rep files a Triage Call EOD report. The service reads the outcome and moves the lead.
stages.definition: The first (triage) call has happened. Outcome, objection and next step are captured on the EOD report.

stages.name: 6. Post-Triage Nurture
stages.advances_via: Automatic. The post-triage asset pack is emailed with tracked links; opening any asset advances the lead.
stages.definition: Post-triage VSL, offer documents and proof assets delivered. Engagement per asset is tracked individually.

stages.name: 7. Closing Call
stages.advances_via: The closer files a Closing Call EOD report. Won moves to Payment; Lost or Follow-up is written back with the reason.
stages.definition: The closing call has happened. Tier pitched, ticket, objection and decision captured.

stages.name: 8. Payment
stages.advances_via: Automatic. Your contract or payment tool writes the tier, ticket and paid date; GHL moves to Awaiting Payment then Closed.
stages.definition: Agreement signed and first payment collected. Cash collected and deal size are on the row.

stages.name: 9. Onboarding
stages.advances_via: Automatic. The client pipeline in GHL reaching its onboarding stage.
stages.definition: Client onboarded and delivery has started.

_tiers_note: Offer tiers written to the Tier column on Sales when a deal closes.
_cohort_note: Conversion is measured from this date forward. Override per request with /api?action=recompute&since=YYYY-MM-DD, or &since=all.
_stage_floor_note: A CRM stage never lowers a lead's journey stage. It only raises it. Follow-Up deliberately has no floor: it says nothing about how far the lead actually got.
_site_pages_note: Paths on your website the tracker should name in Site Sessions. Anything else is recorded as 'other'.
_import_dates_note: Days on which rows were bulk-imported into Notion rather than captured live. A row created on one of these days with no Applied date is treated as historical backfill and left out of conversion maths.
_metric_source_note: How each stage's Entered/Advanced is counted. 'cohort' = leads that reached the stage. 'setter' = conversations logged on the setter EOD tab, because every row in Sales is already past the DM. 'asset' = sent vs actually watched, because a lead lifted past a VSL stage by a CRM stage change never proves the VSL was seen. 'sessions' = live site tracking: visits recorded by t.js, and how many of them completed the application.
_booking_note: Triage and closing booking links shown on the watch pages. A per-lead Calendly Link on the Sales row always wins over these.
_session_min_sample_note: Stage 2 is not scored until this many site sessions exist, so a handful of early visits never reads as a bottleneck.

eod._comment: The EOD report system: where each report posts in Discord, who the team are, and when the nightly digest goes out. Team, targets and times can all be changed later on /settings.

discord._note: Discord ids (Developer Mode on, right click, Copy ID). Leave blank to skip posting: reports still file to Notion. setter takes setter reports; closer takes triage and closing reports; digest is the nightly standup; logs gets errors.

eod._team_note: One entry per person per seat. discord is their Discord user id (right click, Copy User ID) so reminders can @mention them. aka lists other spellings that should count as the same person. One person can sit in two seats: add them twice with different roles.
eod._roles_note: Optional Discord role ids, used to mention a whole seat.
eod._pathways_note: The offers or packages a lead can lean towards on the triage and closing reports.
